lesson-intro.text: Let's cut an orange in half and look inside. There's a wheel in there. Watch how it comes together, then it's your turn.

peel-left.text: First the peel, a big circle. From the top, curve round the left to the bottom.

peel-right.text: Back at the top, curve round the right. The circle closes at the bottom.

inside-left.text: A second circle sits just inside the first. Draw its left half.

inside-right.text: Then its right half. That ring is the peel.

middle.text: Draw a small circle right in the middle.

spokes-plus.text: Draw four spokes out from the little circle, like a plus sign. Stop short of the ring.

spokes-x.text: Next, one spoke between each pair, like a letter X. Now there are eight.

tops-right.text: Each segment gets a rounded top. Curve from spoke tip to spoke tip down the right side.

tops-left.text: Carry on round like a clock, up the left side. The wheel is full.

segments.text: Color all eight segments golden yellow.

rest.text: Color the gaps cream, and the little circle too.

lesson-outro.text: One juicy orange half, all yours. Count the segments. There should be eight.
